item.title: ITScape — KVM/arm64 vGIC-ITS Guest-to-Host VM Escape (CVE-2026-46316)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.3) — binary · CVE-2026-46316 (GHSA-qcxh-2cm7-9fcc). Status: Weaponized. Affects: Linux kernel, KVM/arm64 in-kernel vGIC-ITS (Interrupt Translation Service) emulation (arch/arm64/kvm/vgic/vgic-its.c). Tags: linux-kernel, kvm, arm64, vgic-its, guest-to-host-escape, vm-escape, double-free, use-after-free, kaslr-bypass, heap-grooming, virtualization.
